Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 15.09.2026.

Introduction

Thank you for using Equiv Ratio Solver Plus.

Information Collection and Use

The app does not automatically collect or transmit personal or non-personal user data to the developer or to an app server. Data you enter and save, such as proportionality values, notes, and settings, is stored locally on your device. Files you choose to save are also stored on your device. Device backup behavior is controlled by Android and your device settings.

Data Sharing and Third Parties

The app does not include analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking services. If you choose to use the app's Share feature, the content you select is passed to Android's sharing interface and may be sent to the recipient or service you choose. Opening an external link, such as Wikipedia, also connects to the selected website. These actions are initiated by you; the app does not send this content automatically.

Contact

If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact us at:
mailto:scaynialp@gmail.com

Changes to This Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated as needed. Changes will be published in the app.
